summary: Iter39 sidebar/content gap fix VERIFIED. Removed paddingLeft on AuthShell content pane + added flexShrink/flexGrow:0 on tablet dock — dead space is gone. Tablet expanded gap = 16px (well under 32px budget). Collapse retiles content correctly. Mobile drawer regression passes. No new console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthShell now uses `{flex:1, minWidth:0}` for the content pane, and sidebar (Animated.View with width=220/64) is a flex sibling — this is the correct RN-Web pattern; no double shift.
Sidebar dock has flexShrink:0/flexGrow:0 + explicit width — dock holds its exact width in the row and content pane consumes remainder cleanly.
useSidebar/currentSidebarWidth imports were removed from _layout.tsx as claimed — file is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidebar shell layout is verified stable across tablet expanded/collapsed and mobile. AuthShell content pane is `{flex:1, minWidth:0}` with no paddingLeft. Any future padding on the content pane must be added inside the pane (not the shell) to avoid re-introducing the double-shift dead space.
rca_of_issue: Prior iter had the AuthShell applying BOTH a docked sidebar (Animated.View sibling occupying flex width) AND a paddingLeft equal to sidebar width on the content pane — double shift produced ~220px of dead space. Fix: dropped paddingLeft; content pane just does {flex:1, minWidth:0}. Verified expanded gap=16px, collapsed gap=16px (natural 16px overview-header padding only). Content pane left edge moves from 220px→64px on collapse as expected.
